# FG-GIT-0038

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_head_that_moved_supersedes_the_attempt` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自動修正の途中で MR のブランチが更新されたので、自動修正のコミットは積みませんでした。新しいコミットで改めて確かめます。
- en: The merge request's branch changed while the automatic fix ran, so its commit was not added. The new commit is checked again.
- id: Branch merge request berubah saat perbaikan otomatis berjalan, sehingga commit-nya tidak ditambahkan. Commit baru akan diperiksa lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C14 (ADR-0017 §1.1): the source branch was not at the head the attempt started from when the bot's commit was to land (a person or an agent pushed, or the merge request was closed or retargeted). The bot never overwrites a person's commit and never force-pushes: the attempt is `superseded` and its commit stays unreferenced. Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge.autofix.superseded` (info) with `attempt_id`, `expected_sha`, `actual_sha`. SELECT state, reason FROM forge.autofix_attempts WHERE merge_request_id = <id> ORDER BY id DESC.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing. A new failing pipeline or conflict on the new head starts a new attempt.
